Show another paywall at a location to everyone its --when conditions hold for, in place of what the
location shows everyone else; they are outside an experiment running there. Rules are read in order
after pins, and the first that matches decides. With --env test, only apps using a test key are
answered.

A condition is '<what> <how> [<values>]'. What is platform, app_version, os_version, country, locale
or trait:<key>. How is in, not in, >=, <, is set or is not set. Values are separated by commas.
Repeat --when; all conditions must hold.

Usage:
  voidhash location rule add [location] [paywall] [flags]

Arguments:
  location  The location's slug, name or id
  paywall   The paywall's slug, name or id

Flags:
      --env <production|test>  Whose apps the rule answers: production (the default), whose rules
                               answer every app, or test, whose rules answer apps using a test key
                               only and are read first there
      --first                  Read it before the location's other rules instead of after them
  -h, --help                   Show help for this command
      --json                   Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>            A name for the rule
      --project <project>      Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                               this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                  Print only ids, one per line
      --when <condition>       A condition the rule matches by, such as 'country in DE,AT' or
                               'trait:beta is set'; all of them must hold (can be repeated)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash location rule add home annual --when 'country in DE,AT' --name Germany
  voidhash location rule add home pro --when 'app_version >= 2.4' --when 'trait:beta is set' --first
  voidhash location rule add home pro --when 'platform in ios' --env test
